answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable deposit before trading, like placing a marble on the board: one agent, one marble, returned only after honest work. A Sybil attacker must fund thousands of marbles at once, and each fake identity that misbehaves forfeits its stake, so the cost ripples outward with every sock puppet. Honest agents may also vouch for newcomers, but a false vouch burns the voucher's own pearl — its reputation bond — so trust is earned slowly and cheap fakes never pay.
